about.title: About Us | PUJO SONGI — Siliguri Puja Guide | PUJO SONGI
paragraphs: Born in Siliguri • For North Bengal   Crafted in Siliguri to make every pandal hopper's journey memorable.  PUJO SONGI (পুজো সঙ্গী) is an authentic, crowd-aware digital companion designed to help families, youth, and visitors explore Siliguri's grand Durga Puja festival with less traffic stress and more cultural joy.

Our Siliguri Roots   Why We Built PUJO SONGI  Every autumn, Siliguri transforms into a vibrant carnival of art, lights, and spirituality. From the historic alleys of Hakimpara and Rathkhola to the sprawling spectacles of Central Colony, Subrata Sangha, and Champasari — over a million people step out to celebrate.

Yet, navigating the city during festive evenings has always been fraught with confusion: conflicting WhatsApp forward lists, sudden one-way barricades by Siliguri Metropolitan Police, and exhausting gridlocks on Hill Cart Road and Sevoke Road.
Headquartered right here in  Collegepara, Siliguri (PIN 734005) , we set out to build a platform that respects the real geography of our city.

Zero Fabricated Information   We believe in genuine integrity. We don't simulate fake live traffic or mock sensor feeds. Every pandal coordinate is verified on ground, and our algorithmic route planner groups stops into logically clustered walking and riding circuits.

Preserving Heritage & Traditions   Beyond mere navigation, PUJO SONGI celebrates the soul of Siliguri's Puja — from the dawn tarpan at Mahananda River Ghats on Mahalaya morning to midnight dhak beats and Sandhi Puja rituals.
Built with modern web technologies, accessible performance, and deep local knowledge.
83+ Verified Pandals  Categorized by art themes, traditional idols, eco-friendly concepts, and crowd intensity.
Curated Hopping Circuits  Smart circuits designed for walking, two-wheelers, and family cars with kids and elders.
Community Curation  Active coordination with local clubs, residents, and civic volunteers across Siliguri.
Neighborhood Focus  Dedicated guides for Hakimpara, Rathkhola, Sevoke Road, Pradhan Nagar, Bagdogra & more.
Located at  Collegepara, Siliguri, West Bengal — 734005 . For committee partnerships, advertising inquiries, or volunteering, we are always eager to connect.

paragraphs: Legal & Data Transparency  Privacy Policy    Effective Date: September 1, 2026 • Last Updated: September 29, 2026

At  PUJO SONGI (পুজো সঙ্গী)  ("we," "our," or "us"), accessible from   https://pujosongi.site , we consider the privacy of our visitors to be of paramount importance. This Privacy Policy document outlines the types of information that is received and collected by PUJO SONGI and how it is used, especially regarding Google AdSense, third-party advertising, device storage, and analytics.

PUJO SONGI is designed as an accessible public cultural directory and navigation companion for Durga Puja festival goers in Siliguri and North Bengal. We do not require visitors to create an account or provide personal identity credentials to browse pandals, inspect maps, or view routes.
Information you provide voluntarily:

2. Google AdSense & Third-Party Advertising   Google is a third-party vendor on our website. Google uses cookies, specifically the  DoubleClick DART cookie , to serve advertisements to our site visitors based on their visit to  pujosongi.site  and other websites on the Internet.
Important disclosures regarding Google advertising:
Like almost all modern websites, PUJO SONGI uses standard cookies and browser LocalStorage:

PUJO SONGI follows a standard procedure of using log files on our hosting servers (LiteSpeed/Apache). These files log visitors when they visit websites. The information collected by log files includes internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users' movement on the website, and gathering broad demographic information.
We comply with the  Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India) , the  General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) , and the  California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) .
You have the following rights regarding any data we handle:
If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us at   [email protected]  .

Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. PUJO SONGI does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will promptly remove such information from our records.
By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
